body.name: Rprime
body.def: For a history in \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\), stage \(k\), and \(j=(C,s)\in J\), set \(U'_{nksi}=N_{nks}^{-1}\{\sum_l\mathbf 1[\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksl}<\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksi}]+\tfrac12\sum_l\mathbf 1[\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksl}=\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksi}]\}\), \(\bar U'_{nks}=N_{nks}^{-1}\sum_iU'_{nksi}\), and \(S_{nks}^{\prime2,U}=(N_{nks}-1)^{-1}\sum_i(U'_{nksi}-\bar U'_{nks})^2\). With the candidate assignment \(z'_{nks}\), define \(D_{nks}^{R\prime}=m_{nks}^{-1}\sum_i z'_{nksi}U'_{nksi}-(N_{nks}-m_{nks})^{-1}\sum_i(1-z'_{nksi})U'_{nksi}\), \(\widehat v_{nks}^{R\prime}=S_{nks}^{\prime2,U}\{m_{nks}^{-1}+(N_{nks}-m_{nks})^{-1}\}\), and \(R'_{kj}=D_{nks}^{R\prime}/\sqrt{\widehat v_{nks}^{R\prime}}\) when the quotas and variance are nondegenerate; otherwise set \(R'_{kj}=0\).
